product_metadata.title: Virah Bella Quilted Throw Blanket 50" x 60" Buffalo Plaid Black Primitive Lightweight Throw Quilt Great for Loungers & Extra Bedding - Beautiful Lodge-Themed Blanket
features: Relax in your oversized chair, bed, or any spot at home under the cozy style of this throw blanket fashioned with a lovely lodge print design.
Our reversible throw quilt enhances room decor with stylish comfort and is fade and shrink resistant for years of enjoyable use.
It's a lightweight throw blanket that's great for any season, making it a fantastic couch throw, recliner cover, or bed quilt all year long.
So soft and comfy, this quilt blanket is made of breathable polyester fabric with a poly-blend fill that won't pill and resists static.
Machine washable for easy care, this 50" x 60" colorful quilt is a perfect addition to your home and an excellent gift for friends and family.
description: Find harmony and relax in your oversized chair, bed, or any cozy spot at home with this beautiful Virah Bella Quilted Throw. This soft and lightweight blanket with a lovely lodge print is a great throw blanket for the couch, recliner cover, or a bed throw in year-round weather. Its reversible design gives you plenty of style options and is fade and shrink resistant for years of enjoyable use. Made of a soft, cozy, and breathable polyester shell with poly-blend fill, our quilted throw won't pill and resists static. Easy care and machine washable, this 50" x 60" colorful quilt is perfect for any room in your home and makes a fantastic gift for friends and family.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash in cold water with similar colors, tumble dry on low heat. Do not bleach, dry clean or iron
